description.value: Herald Park fronts the west shore of Shuswap Lake with a large roped swimming beach, forested uplands, and a self-guided trail to Margaret Falls; a busy, popular frontcountry park that works well as a base for Shuswap-area touring.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this 'Homestead campground' operated by Silvertip Park Services Ltd., but the linked website is the BC Parks page for 'Herald Park' — Homestead is a campground within Herald Provincial Park. The website confirms frontcountry camping, a 'Book camping' link indicating reservations, and internet_access=no is corroborated by no mention of WiFi on the website. Most amenity details (showers, potable water, hiker/biker sites) are absent from the website content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM record is 'Homestead campground' but the linked website is the BC Parks page for 'Herald Park' — Homestead appears to be one campground loop within the broader park. A dedicated page for Homestead campground specifically may exist but was not available.
Phone number (+1-250-320-9305) could not be confirmed from website content — the BC Parks page does not display it.
No address in OSM record; location is described narratively as 14 km east of Trans-Canada Highway at Tappen.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate operated campground within a BC provincial park on a popular cycling touring corridor; reservations accepted and a sanitary dump station confirmed via OSM, making it a useful directory entry for touring cyclists in the Shuswap.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM also records email parkinquiries@telus.net and sanitary_dump_station=yes; neither could be confirmed or denied from the fetched website content.

wow_evidence: large roped swimming beach... self-guided trail to Margaret Falls
